text:
2010 FIFA Wiadi Kɔp a wɔyɛe wɔ South Africa fi 11 June kɔsi 11 July no, na ɛyɛ akansi a edi kan a wɔyɛe wɔ Afrika asase so. Akuo 32 na ɛde dii agorɔ, wɔkyekyee mu kɔɔ akuo awotwe a ɛwɔ anan anan mu; akuo a ɛdi kan mmienu firi akuo biara mu kɔɔ single-elimination knockout phase a ɛwɔ round of 16, quarter-finals, semi-finals, third-place play-off ne final mu.

Group stage no de ntetɛɛntɛɛ baa nsesaeɛ mu. Ɔman a ɛyɛ host South Africa bɛyɛɛ host a edi kan a wɔtwa no firi group stage mu, ɛwom sɛ finalists a ɛfiri 2006, Italy ne France nso firii mu ansa na knockout rounds no reba. Bere a akuo no reku tia mu no, Uruguay bɛyɛɛ ahoɔden a ɛyɛ anigyeɛ, kɔɔ semi-finals mu na ɛwiee wɔ mmiɛnsa mu, Diego Forlán na ɔde wɔn kɔɔ anim.

Final no a wɔbɔɔ wɔ Soccer City wɔ Johannesburg no, Spain ne Netherlands na ɛne wɔn hyiaeɛ. Wɔ agorɔ a ɛyɛ den a ɛnni goal mu a ɛtrɛɛ kɔɔ extra time mu no, Andrés Iniesta siee agorɔ no wɔ sima 116 mu, de 1–0 dii nkunim. Esiane sɛ Spain nyaa World Cup title a ɛdi kan wɔ mu nti, ɛbɛyɛɛ European ɔman a edi kan a ɔde dii nkunim wɔ tournament no mu wɔ Europe akyi. Germany nyaa mmiɛnsa mu.

Honours no kɔɔ akuo a ɛdi anim no mu. Thomas Müller a ɔfiri Germany nyaa Golden Boot ɛwom sɛ agorɔfo anan wiee wɔ goals 5—Müller, David Villa a ɔfiri Spain, Wesley Sneijder a ɔfiri Netherlands ne Forlán a ɔfiri Uruguay—na wɔde assists tiebreaker maa Müller, ɛfiri sɛ ɔde 3 baa. Forlán nyaa Golden Ball sɛ agorɔfo a ɔyɛ yie paa wɔ tournament no mu, ɛwom sɛ Spain Iker Casillas nyaa Golden Glove sɛ goalkeeper a ɔyɛ yie paa.

Akansi no nyaa nnipa 3,178,856 a wɔbaa agorɔ no mu wɔ matches 64 mu, na ɛyɛ 49,670 wɔ game biara mu. Akyire no, 2010 edition no yɛɛ nsesaeɛ wɔ firsts mu: World Cup wɔ Afrika asase so, European ɔhene a wɔde hyɛɛ Europe akyi, host a wɔtwa no wɔ opening round mu, ne Spain maiden world title.
